lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid consisting of five primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs extending from the posterior branchial region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a series of high-contrast anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 12 high-luminance blobs arranged in a semi-random cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: Several dark, elongated silhouettes consistent with symbiotic Echeneidae are visible along the ventral-lateral margin and posterior to the pectoral fin.
